text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale Lakeside holds 12 tablets of zolpidem tartrate 12.5 mg with 5.4 days of supply at 2.2 tablets per day. Corvale East holds 216 tablets with 34.8 days of supply at 6.2 tablets per day and can spare 19 tablets while retaining 32 days on hand. Corvale General holds 135 tablets with 16.6 days of supply. The top-ranked option is to transfer 19 tablets from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside, raising Lakeside to 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include zolpidem tartrate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest way to protect Lakeside's supply without relying on external purchasing. Corvale East has sufficient excess inventory to support the transfer while maintaining its own adequate stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Approve transfer of 19 tablets of zolpidem tartrate 12.5 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval and a controlled-substance transfer record for Schedule III-V.
2. Execute the controlled-substance transfer documentation — requires pharmacy director sign-off.
3. Monitor days-of-supply at all three sites weekly — requires buyer and pharmacy director review.

Not recommended: Purchasing from ACI Healthcare USA, Inc., Aurobindo Pharma Limited, or Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. at this time; none are on FDA's shortage list and their labels name no identifiable manufacturing plant for verification.
